usedFor: DitCal holds your bookings, and HubSpot keeps the people when “New Booking” runs “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each booker lands in HubSpot by email, and a repeat booker updates the existing contact instead of duplicating it.

watchOut: “Booking Cancelled” can run the same action, so build only for the events you want recorded.
